algorithm_contract.candidate_regions: up to 150000 strongest accessibility peaks, extended 250 bp from summit under the registered defaults
algorithm_contract.contact_term: cell-type Hi-C when supplied, otherwise a distance power law
algorithm_contract.formula: for each gene and TSS, Activity times Contact divided by the sum of Activity times Contact over candidate elements within the window
algorithm_contract.input_activity: quantile-normalized ATAC for the primary liver lane; geometric mean with H3K27ac is unavailable and not imputed
algorithm_contract.output: unsigned relative enhancer-gene link score within each gene-TSS neighborhood
algorithm_contract.self_promoter_behavior: self-promoter scores are forced to one by upstream code

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No checkpoint exists or is admitted.

input_contract.canonical_reference: GRCh38.p14 and a project-derived GENCODE v49 TSS/gene authority; the bundled hg38 gene files are not admitted silently
input_contract.gse296875_activity: ATAC insertions pseudobulked by donor and cell state, with candidate peaks, normalization, QC, and pooling fit only from outer-training donors
input_contract.h3k27ac_state: structurally_missing; select the no-H3K27ac lane rather than zero-imputing a track
input_contract.quantile_normalization: Use the pinned upstream K562 reference only as a declared fixed transform. A no-qnorm sensitivity is separately named and cannot replace the primary lane after outcomes are seen.
input_contract.reference_contact_sensitivity: A MegaMap/contact sensitivity may run only if the exact contact artifact, rights, build, normalization, resolution, and checksum are frozen before submission. It is never selected using holdout outcomes.
input_contract.reference_mismatch: The registered upstream config uses its own hg38 collapsed gene bounds. GENCODE v49 changes the TSS roster and score denominator, so this is a declared project adaptation and upstream binary calibration is not assumed to transfer.
input_contract.variant_mapping: Intersect evaluator-provided variant positions with the full frozen candidate-element intervals using explicit 0-based half-open coordinates. Keep continuous ABC scores.

output_and_task_contract.sealed_behavior: Use a cell-state link atlas built entirely from development ATAC before selection lock. GSE289173 has no ATAC, so ABC cannot create donor-specific sealed links.
output_and_task_contract.typed_graph_output: unsigned typed enhancer_to_gene edge with source, cell state, observability, and continuous score
output_and_task_contract.variant_endpoint_status: eligible as an unsigned link/retrieval baseline or component, not as a standalone signed eQTL/ieQTL predictor
output_and_task_contract.variant_overlap_helper: prohibited; upstream getVariantOverlap.py hard-codes score and distance filters, shrinks regions, and invokes shell commands instead of honoring the benchmark contract

Source text was inspected without installing dependencies, downloading reference/contact data, or executing the pipeline.
